data.title: HIV awareness gap puts young people at risk
data.description: Young people aged 15-24 remain at the highest risk of new HIV infections because many are unaware of prevention services, the Thai Red Cross has warned.

data.title: Park chief faces visit probe
data.description: The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) has ordered an inquiry into whether the chief of Similan Islands National Park violated a departmental order by allowing a House budget committee member and his group to stay overnight in the park about four years ago.

data.title: Resort begins demolition of buildings in national park
data.description: Another tourism operator has agreed to demolish all buildings encroaching on Thap Lan National Park, Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said yesterday.

data.title: Doctors warned about social media
data.description: The Medical Council of Thailand has warned doctors to exercise greater caution when using social media as authorities intensify a nationwide crackdown on illegal health advertising amid a surge in misleading online promotions by influencers.

data.title: Tiger attack sparks safety review
data.description: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.

data.title: Myanmar targets growth in trade
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar have pledged to deepen economic cooperation, reopen key trade routes and accelerate investment as both countries seek to raise bilateral trade to US$12 billion (397 billion baht).

data.title: Senator urges dissolution of NBTC board
data.description: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.

data.title: MoUs boost Myanmar ties
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar signed three memoranda of understanding (MoUs) on Thursday aimed at deepening bilateral cooperation in labour, transboundary water quality management and space technology.

data.title: Tiger that killed ranger was juvenile, not a man-eater
data.description: The tiger that killed a wildlife ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was not fully grown, still learning to hunt and failed to meet the definition of a "man-eater", the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Thursday.

data.title: Chon Buri burial site scan finds no additional bodies
data.description: CHON BURI: An extensive search of a coconut plantation in Bang Lamung district linked to the high-profile murder of two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has turned up no additional bodies, according to police.

data.title: House committee member who criticised Similan park lodging faces probe
data.description: The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) has launched an investigation into whether the chief of Mu Ko Similan National Park improperly allowed an adviser to the parliamentary committee vetting the 2027 budget bill to stay overnight on the Similan Islands despite a long-standing accommodation ban, after the adviser criticised park conditions during a budget debate.

data.title: Songkhla officer accused of sexual exploitation surrenders
data.description: The police officer in Songkhla province accused of forcing women to record pornographic content, with some allegedly coerced to avoid criminal charges, surrendered at Thung Lung police station on Wednesday night.

data.title: Heart failure may have killed Hlun Solo, poisoning not ruled out
data.description: The Central Institute of Forensic Science (CIFS), under the Justice Ministry, conducted an autopsy on the body of popular travel YouTuber Hlun Solo on Thursday and found that heart failure could be a cause while poison has not been ruled out.

data.title: Ex-department chief faces six charges in recruitment exam fraud probe
data.description: The Crime Suppression Division (CSD) has filed six serious charges against Theerut Suphawiboonphol, former director-general of the Department of Local Administration (DLA), over his alleged role in a local government recruitment exam fraud.

data.title: Inquiry launched into Similan overnight visit by budget adviser
data.description: The Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment has launched an investigation into whether the chief of Mu Ko Similan National Park improperly allowed an adviser to the parliamentary committee vetting the 2027 budget bill to stay overnight on the Similan Islands despite a long-standing accommodation ban, after the adviser criticised park conditions during a budget debate.

data.title: B100,000 bounty on robbers of Chiang Rai gold shop
data.description: Police have offered a cash reward of 100,000 baht for clues leading to the arrest of two armed robbers, believed to be Lao nationals, who made off with about 13 million baht worth of gold ornaments from a shop in Chiang Rai and fled across the Mekong River into Laos.

data.title: Thailand to adopt checked baggage opening without owners present
data.description: Authorities in Thailand will be able to open air travellers’ checked baggage for security reasons without an owner’s consent starting on Oct 16, but the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has affirmed that checks will follow strict guidelines.

data.title: Myanmar leader in Thailand on legitimacy quest
data.description: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing received a red-carpet treatment as he began an official visit to Thailand on Thursday, part of efforts by Bangkok to push for re-engagement between its war-torn neighbour and Asean.

data.title: Woman sexually assaulted while sleeping on Dubai-Bangkok flight
data.description: A Thai woman has described waking up to find a fellow passenger touching her inappropriately during an overnight flight from Dubai to Bangkok, next to her four-year-old daughter.

data.title: New Zealand PM open to referendum on electoral system
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said on Thursday he was open to a referendum on whether to change the country’s electoral system, opening another split in his centre-right coalition months ahead of a general election.

data.title: Body of popular Thai YouTuber Hlun Solo returns home
data.description: The body of the popular Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo was returned to Thailand early Thursday morning, as his family prepared to seek an autopsy to find the cause of his death in Georgia last month.
